spans.s: प्लु vt. 1Ā (pp. प्लुत; pres. प्लवते) 1. To float, to swim, बालाः क्लेशोत्तरं रागवशात्प्लवंते R.xvi.60, मज्जंत्यलाबूनि ग्रावाणः प्लवंत इति Mv.i.; 2. to fly, to soar, to hover; 3. to jump, to leap, to spring, Bt.v.48, xiv.13; 4. to be lengthened (as a vowel).With अभि-, to overflow, to overwhelm.With अव-, to jump, to jump out.With आ-, 1. to bathe; 2. to jump up.With उद्-, 1. to float, to swim; 2. to spring, to leap, M.viii.236.With उप-, 1. to float; 2. to assault, to attack; 3. to trouble, to harass, to torment, तस्मिन्नवसरे देवाः पौलस्त्योपप्लुता हरिम् । अभिजग्मुः R.x.5, xiv.64.With परि-, 1. to swim, to float; 2. to bathe; 3. to overwhelm; 4. to jump, to spring; 5. to flood, to inundate; 6. to curer with.With वि-, 1. to float about, to fluctuate; 2. to be scattered; 3. to become confused; 4. to be ruined.With सम्-, 1. to float about, to fluctuate; 2. to meet, e.g. आपः संप्लवंते.

प्लु Caus. (प्लावयति-ते) 1. to cause to swim, to cause to float; 2. to remove, to wash away; 3. to cause to stagger.With वि-, 1. to cause to swim; 2. to spread abroad, to divulge; 3. to confound, to confuse.
प्लुत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Floating, swimming; 2. inundated, overflowed; 3. jumped, leaped; 4. protracted, lengthened (as a vowel), (pp. of प्लु q.v.).
प्लुत (II) n. 1. A jump, a leap; 2. a particular pace of a horse.
प्लुत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Floating, swimming; 2. inundated, overflowed; 3. jumped, leaped; 4. protracted, lengthened (as a vowel), (pp. of प्लु q.v.).
प्लुत-गति (II) f. 1. going by leaps; 2. galloping.
प्लुति f. 1. Overflowing; 2. a. leap, a jump, a skip; 3. a particular pace of a horse; 4. protraction (of a vowel).
प्लुष् (I) vt. 1P, 4P (pres. प्लेषति, प्लुष्यति) To burn, to scorch, Rt.i.22.
प्लुष् (II) vt. or vi. 9P (pres. प्लुष्णाति) 1. To sprinkle; 2. to fill; 3. to be wet.
